arabic text: ZANJEERO’N ME JAHKRA HUWA HAI AABID E BEEMAR
english translation text: The Prophet's daughters are unveiled, and this is Shaam's marketplace. The ailing Abid is bound in chains.

arabic text: NAA BHAAYI KOI SAATH HAI NA SAR PE RIDAEE’N\nMAJMA HAI TAMASHAI HAI BAAGHI KI SADAAEI’N\nROTA HAI SINA PER SAR E ABBAS E ALAMDAAR
english translation text: No brother remains beside them, and no chadar covers their heads.\nThere is a crowd, spectators and cries calling them rebels.\nUpon the spear, Abbas's head weeps.

arabic text: HAD HOGAYI SAADAAT KO MAARE GAYE PATHAR\nSAB KHOON MEI’N TAR HO GAYE YOO’N ZAKHMI HUWA SAR\nMARO YEH ALI ZAADI HAIN KEHTE RAHE AGHYAAR
english translation text: Oppression reached its limit: stones were thrown at the Sayyids.\nTheir heads were wounded and drenched in blood.\nThe strangers kept shouting: strike them—they are Ali's daughters.

arabic text: PHENKA GAYA SAJJAD PE JAB KHOLTA PAANI\nFIZA SE YEH KEHNE LAGI’N PHIR FAITMA SAANI\nMAZLOOM HAI KITNA MERA YEH QAAFLA SALAAR
english translation text: When boiling water was poured upon Sajjad,\nthe second Fatima said to Fizza:\nhow oppressed is the leader of my caravan.

arabic text: AMMO CHALE AAWO MERA MUSHKIL HUWA JEENA\nGHAZI KO BULAATI RAHI’N RO RO KE SAKINA\nZAALIM KE TAMANCHON SE JAB ZAKHMI HUWE RUKHSAAR
english translation text: Uncle, come—living has become unbearable.\nSakina wept and called Ghazi\nwhen the tyrant's slaps wounded her cheeks.

arabic text: AISE BHI SUNATE RAHE RAHO’N ME SITMAGAR\nWHO PANI BAHATE RAHE PYAASO’N KO DIKHA KAR\nHANSTE RAHE SAADAT KI GHURBAT PE WOH HAR BAAR
english translation text: The oppressors tormented them even along the roads.\nThey showed water to the thirsty and poured it away,\nthen laughed again and again at the Sayyids' helplessness.

arabic text: SOCHO TO ZARA KAISE QADAM RAKH KE UTHAYA\nJAB RAAH ME SAJJAD KO KAANTO’N PE CHALAYA\nNEZE SE KAHA SHAH NE HAYE HAYE MERA BEEMAR
english translation text: Imagine how he placed one foot before the other\nwhen Sajjad was forced to walk over thorns.\nFrom the spear, the King cried: alas, my sick son.

arabic text: CHAADAR KA JO IK ZAKHM THA AUR HOGAYA GEHRA\nBAALO’N SE CHUPATI RAHI SAB BIBIYAN CHEHRA\nJAB SHOR UTHA AAGAYA AB SHAAM KA BAZAAR
english translation text: The wound of the stolen chadar grew deeper.\nAll the ladies hid their faces behind their hair\nwhen the cry arose: Shaam's marketplace has arrived.

arabic text: BULWAYI GAYI SHAAM KE DARBAR MEIN ZAINAB\nBE PARDA PHIRAAYI GAYI BAAZAAR MEIN ZAINAB\nZEESHAN O KARIM IS LIYE ROTA HAI’N AZADAAR
english translation text: Zainab was summoned to Shaam's court,\nand paraded unveiled through the marketplace.\nThis is why Zeeshan and Karim's mourners weep.
